answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 10845 Country: Canada Title: Asak Mufti Saheb, Thanks a lot for answering my question.Fatwa Id 10582,(Fatwa: 124/125=D/1429).You replied that :"You may keep any of the two names: Ahmad or Muhammad".I am sorry but the response is a bit unclear to me.Does that mean that Ahmed or Mohammad can be either first or the last name.If,they can also be the last name or middle names,Can I keep my son's first name after any other name?Like:Ayaan Ahmed or Ayaan Mohammad .I just want to make sure that "Ahmed or Mohammad" can be the last names or not?Can I keep the first name of my child by any other 99 names of Prophet Mohammad(P.B.U.H) as well? I would relly appreciate your response. Thanks for your patience. Question: Asak Mufti Saheb, Thanks a lot for answering my question.Fatwa Id 10582,(Fatwa: 124/125=D/1429).You replied that :"You may keep any of the two names: Ahmad or Muhammad".I am sorry but the response is a bit unclear to me.Does that mean that Ahmed or Mohammad can be either first or the last name.If,they can also be the last name or middle names,Can I keep my son's first name after any other name?Like:Ayaan Ahmed or Ayaan Mohammad .I just want to make sure that "Ahmed or Mohammad" can be the last names or not?Can I keep the first name of my child by any other 99 names of Prophet Mohammad(P.B.U.H) as well? I would relly appreciate your response. Thanks for your patience. Answer ID: 10845 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 332/299=D/1430) (1) Yes, you can keep the name: Ayan Ahmad or Ayan Muhammad. (2) You can choose any name from the names of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
